answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared reef of collateral before it can trade: like shale layers that only form under sustained pressure, reputation accrues slowly from verified completed work, not from account creation. New identities start with zero trust and a low transaction tide - small caps that rise only as they deliver. An attacker spawning a thousand fakes must fund a thousand stakes and wait out the same slow build, so each fake costs real capital and time while honest agents earn their limits back.
